data.name: Nimr
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-m-r', meaning 'lion' or 'tiger'. In Islamic tradition, Nimr is the name of a Prophet and a king mentioned in the Quran. He was a just and righteous ruler who upheld the truth and defended the weak against oppression. He is an inspiring figure of courage and strength.
